notes:
Account summary:
- Enterprise banking client evaluating private inference for customer support automation and regulatory summarization. Strong emphasis on private networking (PrivateLink) and on-prem options for auditability and data residency.

Timeline (key bullets):
- 2025-01-10: MQL -> AE outreach (Jordan). Initial discovery call with ops + platform. Confirmed use cases: chat support for agents, nightly doc summarization pipeline, compliance extraction.
- 2025-01-24: Demo (hosted + dedicated) with SE (Priya). Showed latency profiles and dedicated capacity options. Customer asked specifically about PrivateLink + VPC endpoints.
- 2025-02-14: POC kickoff (sandbox). Fireflies transcript: ff_2025-02-14_NGTC_demo_98a2. POC scope: 2-week integration, test routing via PrivateLink to ensure no egress to public internet.
- 2025-02-28: Security questionnaire returned. Key ask: native AWS PrivateLink support or an on-prem appliance. Requested audit logging cadence and KMS integration details.
- 2025-03-10: Internal roadmap alignment call. We communicated current Private offering (VPC peering + IP allowlist) and that full PrivateLink integration was scheduled for later in Q3 roadmap.
- 2025-03-18: Security team escalated: "We cannot accept anything that requires internet egress or IP allowlists; must be PrivateLink or on-prem." Customer procurement also flagged upcoming budget freeze for Q2.
- 2025-03-22: Final update call — customer says competitor (LargeCloudAI) committed to enterprise PrivateLink integration and shortened timeline, and Northgate placed procurement hold due to budget reallocation and leadership changes. No clear internal champion after VP of Platform left.

POC results / technical notes:
- Dedicated config performed well for latency; throughput targets (p95 < 120ms for support flows) met in sandbox.
- Prefix caching reduced token cost by ~18% in test runs.
- Security review blocked on networking — current offering requires customers to accept route via managed control plane; security flagged as unacceptable.
- SE notes: integration complexity expected to drop significantly once PrivateLink is available, but roadmap timing (Q3) does not meet customer's procurement timeline.

Decision / Reason lost (current state):
- Closed-lost (de-prioritized) — primary reasons: lack of immediate PrivateLink support, budget freeze, and no internal sponsor after reorg. Customer verbally indicated they are moving forward with LargeCloudAI who committed to PrivateLink + enterprise contract alignment.

- Send short technical one-pager summarizing mitigations and timeline for PrivateLink + contact mapping.
